spec: Remove duplicate email addresses from a list. Email comparison should be case-insensitive.

inputs.note: Tests case-insensitive deduplication where three variants of the same email exist.
Tests full case/whitespace duplication with the first occurrence preserved.
Tests trailing whitespace and mixed case; note that trailing space makes them distinct under strict comparison.
Tests that +tag is treated as part of the local part; these are distinct emails.
Tests leading whitespace on first element; spaces are part of the string.
Tests all-case variations of the same address.
Tests mixed case with duplicate at the end.
Tests TLD-less emails (no dot after domain).
Tests quoted-local-part emails; these are different strings.
Tests duplicate followed by case variant.

def remove_duplicate_emails(emails: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """
    emails: A list of email address strings, possibly with duplicates and mixed case.
    returns: A new list with duplicates removed. Comparison is case-insensitive; the first occurrence's original casing is preserved.
    """
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for email in emails:
        lowered = email.lower()
        if lowered not in seen:
            seen.add(lowered)
            result.append(email)
    return result
